elements.label: Background colleague walking into frame behind the seated pair
Out-of-focus foreground desk equipment at right edge
elements.change_other: slight live-action drift of defocused foreground

pattern.description: Live-action office shot, locked-off framing: a colleague walks in from the left and stops behind two seated workers, smiling, while the narration says 'balance PTO and customer service coverage'.
pattern.why_premium: Story beats come from blocking inside a static cinematic frame, with shallow depth of field and defocused foreground objects, so there is no cut or graphic overlay, which keeps the ad-film look.

build_hint.gsap: Not a motion-graphic build. If recreated with a cut-out: gsap.fromTo(person, {x: -120, opacity: 0.6}, {x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'none'}) over a blurred static plate; optional slow 'sine.inOut' drift on a foreground blur layer for parallax.
build_hint.remotion: Use live footage with <OffthreadVideo>; for a cut-out recreation, translateX = interpolate(frame, [0, 12], [-120, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) with linear easing, foreground layer drifting a few px.

notes: Live-action footage; the diff boxes b03-b14 are small lighting/defocus flicker, not distinct elements. camera.move is none, so no camera move is reported.
